title: Prijedlog zaključka o zaduživanju Vlade RH na donošenje prijedloga Zakona o porezu na neto bogatstvo
summary: Sabor conclusion asking the Government to draft an annual net wealth tax law: EUR 700,000 threshold, rates 1% to 4%, liability by citizenship, exit tax.
status: Submitted 15 September 2023; left undebated when the 10th Sabor was dissolved in March 2024 (Nacional)
